Players Committee card image of [[Uncivilized Blaster]] (first published image; no errata mark), printing: “Deploy on your warrior. May target a character, creature, or vehicle for free. Draw destiny. Target hit if destiny +2 > defense value. If hit by Corran, Kanan, or Obi-Wan, target may not be used to satisfy attrition, and opponent loses 1 Force.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/ee4c4cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/uncivilzed_blaster.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual15-Light/hires/uncivilzed_blaster.png] as of commit ee4c4cd “Set 15 cards + errata images” (22 June 2021).
